name: Equine Advocates Rescue & Sanctuary
region_note: EQUINES (horses, ponies, donkeys) - NYC has little on-the-ground equine rescue; these are regional
notes: Founded 1996; 173-acre sanctuary near Chatham (Columbia County) home to 80+ rescued horses, ponies, donkeys and mules saved from slaughter, abuse and neglect. Runs a Humane Education program that specifically addresses the NYC urban carriage-horse trade. Building a Rehabilitation Center (10 stalls + vet clinic). Regional (upstate) - flagged as not NYC-local, but a relevant intake/education contact for NYC equine-welfare situations.
